name: flask
note: overview: questions of the kind the site's four starter chips ask, which the code-specific sets do not cover. Written at the pinned commit BEFORE any overview retrieval was run, from the repository's file listing and README only (no source file was opened to choose core_files). core_files maps each file a good overview must draw on to one line of reasoning; manifest_files does the same for the dependency questions (these are not indexed by the server, so coverage of them is zero by construction). expected_files repeats the core_files paths so the existing loader accepts the file. The loader only knows the splits dev/test, so split 'dev' is the four dev questions and split 'test' is the four held-out ones; 'test' here means the held-out half of THIS set, scored once, not eval/questions/*.json's test split. Each topic appears once in each split (starter in one, paraphrase in the other), so the halves are not independent in topic.
